description:
[Interviews] Generate a signed link that works for 30 days and can be opened more than once; nothing is sent. Whoever holds the link gets its access. `type` picks who it is for and the ids it needs: interview-for-profile = one candidate's own interview link (interview_profile_id + interview_id); results-for-profile = that candidate's results (interview_profile_id); interview-result-candidate = one result for the candidate, interview-result-talent-seeker = one result for a reviewer (interview_result_id); interview-results-for-position = every result of an active interview or position for a reviewer (interview_id). interview_profile_id is the candidate's `id` from list_candidates. There is no anonymous link to an interview: invitations are sent by invite_candidates.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

interview_id.description: The interview (an interview `id` from list_interviews) or position (a position `id` from list_interviews), a uuid. Required for interview-for-profile and interview-results-for-position.

interview_profile_id.description: The candidate (the `id` of a list_candidates row, a uuid; not a `profile_id` (list_users)). Required for interview-for-profile and results-for-profile.

interview_result_id.description: The interview result (a result id from list_interview_results), a uuid. Required for interview-result-candidate and interview-result-talent-seeker.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Company (a company `id` from list_my_merchants, a uuid) to act for. Honoured for admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

show_menu.description: true shows the navigation menu on the page the link opens; false or left out hides it.

type.description: Which kind of signed URL to generate.

name: generate_interview_url
title: Generate shareable interview link
